title: 3-Cheese Chicken Skillet Bag Meal
steps: Follow the bag directions (skillet, usually 10 to 15 min from frozen, stirring). Don't thaw first unless the bag says to.
Make sure it's steaming hot all the way through (165°F).
Optional add-ins: a handful of extra mozzarella or parmesan at the end, or a cup of frozen broccoli added with the bag contents to stretch it.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R24
